title: Zapier vs Power Automate for Business Automation
verdict: Choose Power Automate if your business runs on Microsoft 365 and needs approvals in Teams or desktop automation. Choose Zapier for connecting many cloud tools quickly, especially outside the Microsoft ecosystem.
seoTitle: Zapier vs Power Automate for Business Automation
seoDescription: Zapier or Microsoft Power Automate for automating business workflows: app coverage, Microsoft 365 fit, pricing model, desktop automation and limits.
summary: Zapier connects thousands of cloud apps with simple trigger-and-action workflows and is easy for non-developers. Power Automate is Microsoft's automation tool, strongest inside Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams and Excel, and it can also automate Windows desktop tasks. Pick by where your work lives.

dataPoints.label: Best fit
dataPoints.value: Zapier: broad cloud app coverage. Power Automate: Microsoft 365 and Windows

dataPoints.label: Desktop automation
dataPoints.value: Power Automate includes desktop (RPA) flows; Zapier is cloud-only

dataPoints.label: Pricing model
dataPoints.value: Zapier: by tasks per month. Power Automate: per user or per flow, often bundled with Microsoft 365 plans

dataPoints.label: Ease of use
dataPoints.value: Zapier is simpler for beginners; Power Automate is powerful but more complex

dataPoints.label: Indian tools
dataPoints.value: Check connectors for Tally, Razorpay and WhatsApp providers; custom code may be needed

dataPoints.label: Alternative
dataPoints.value: n8n for self-hosting and code steps

body:
## When to use custom code instead

For critical, high-volume flows such as order-to-invoice, custom integrations with proper error handling are more reliable. See [workflow automation with n8n, Make or custom code](/blog/workflow-automation-with-n8n-make-or-custom-code-how-to-choose) and our glossary entry on [low-code and no-code](/glossary/low-code).

Prices and plan features change often; check the vendors' current Indian pricing before deciding.

faqs.q: Can Power Automate work with Tally?
faqs.a: Not natively in most cases; it can work through files or a custom connector.

faqs.q: Is Zapier secure enough for business data?
faqs.a: It offers business security features, but limit what data passes through and review access regularly.
